# biznetgio_baremetal_rebuild_os_list (Data Source)

List OS yang valid buat rebuild (`GET /baremetals/{account_id}/rebuild/oss`) — lebih sempit dari OS list create karena ngikutin layout disk instance.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "biznetgio_baremetal_rebuild_os_list" "main" {
  account_id = 12345
}

output "rebuild_oss" {
  value = data.biznetgio_baremetal_rebuild_os_list.main.oss
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `account_id` (Number) Account id baremetal yang mau di-rebuild.

### Read-Only

- `oss` (List of String) List identifier OS (misal `centos7-base`).
- `raw` (String, Sensitive) Full JSON response.
